descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-15 Ask AI · S12 Tracker status × answer wording (active / changed / held / stopped / given / no dose)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U5 The current-medications answer reflects the Medication Tracker; held drugs show as held. (UAT TC-15; TFA-92593 AC 7)
  • U4 Answers are grounded only in that patient's data: no cross-patient bleed, no invented information, no outside data; per 3.4 no guessed units on ambiguous values and no narration of documentation stat … (UAT TC-15; TFA-92593 AC 3; UAT 3.4)

Test design technique: Decision table (decision-table) — List the combinations of several conditions and check each one, to see that the result follows the rule.

Given One tracker row per status, plus one active row with no dose

When Ask "What medications is the patient on?"

Then Active + changed drugs listed as current; held marked held; stopped not presented as current; given marked as one-time; the undosed row quoted as stored, with no 'dose not specified' narration

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Deterministic part: Metoprolol, Furosemide, Lisinopril, Aspirin and 'held' present; no documentation-status narration (3.4, Q11). Stopped/given wording is Q3 — recorded, not judged; S07 checks them as direct questions

Where it ran: dev unit U41; test method AICHECK · AI output check; lane planned in the matrix: AI check (automated)

S12 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-15.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build 43c38a4 (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-14T21:30:04Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AICHECK · AI output check; secondary: AGENT · Browser agent — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
